notes.title: update and bug fix
notes.notes: [p][b][i]1. We added more jersey skins to give players more options to choose from.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b][i]2. We fixed some bugs, such as: in ragdoll, strange bugs sometimes occurred; other bugs occurred when performing lateral rotation maneuvers, causing the rider to fall. There was also a bug in the rider's neck mesh, which we just fixed.[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: Small weekly update
notes.notes: [p][b][i]adicionamos apenas duas animações de truques nessa atualização, rock solid e doublegrab agora fazem parte da trick lis[/i][/b]t. [/p][p]We apologize for any bugs that may occur, but we only noticed minor bugs, nothing that will hinder gameplay, we will be resolving these bugs in the next updates.[/p]

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes: [p][b][i]1- we updated the basic physics, where it is possible for the rider to react by applying his body weight to the bike's suspension[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]2- we fixed bugs[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]3- we updated some rider animations[/i][/b][/p][p][b][i]4- we made other adjustments to the motorcycle's physics, especially during crashs[/i][/b][/p]

notes.title: First update build 00.00.02
notes.notes:
Among the changes;

1. We added a better garage to which we will also make visual improvements

2. We made a better optimization in the game

3. We changed the landing ramps of the current map

4. We fixed small bugs in the event system

5. We added 2 more tricks, superman and shaulin

6. We adjusted the camera system
